source_ref.description: Sandbox reference to the source video. Runner enforces sandbox-scope before passing to ffmpeg.

container.description: Target container format. Closed enum reflects vetted ffmpeg muxers.

video_codec.description: Target video codec. Runner maps to a vetted ffmpeg encoder command template; arbitrary -c:v strings are rejected.

audio_codec.description: Target audio codec. 'copy' preserves the source audio stream.

max_height.description: If set, video is downscaled (never upscaled) to this height with aspect ratio preserved.

target_bitrate_kbps.description: Target video bitrate in kilobits/sec. Mutually informative with crf; runner picks the rate-control mode appropriate for the codec.

crf.description: Constant Rate Factor for x264/x265/libsvtav1. Lower = higher quality. Ignored when target_bitrate_kbps is set.

two_pass.description: When true and using bitrate-target mode, the runner performs a two-pass encode.

max_seconds.description: Hard wall-clock budget. ffmpeg is SIGTERMed at this boundary and timed_out=true is reported.

output_ref.description: Sandbox reference to the transcoded artifact. Lifetime governed by lab policy.

summary: Vetted ffmpeg transcode pipeline — sandbox-in, sandbox-out, no network, hard time budget.
notes: Runner ships a curated ffmpeg static build; user-supplied filter graphs are NOT accepted on this card — use video-edit-graph for that. h265/av1 fall back to slower presets without GPU acceleration; expect minutes-class latency on >2-minute sources.
